summary.text: Ray Pickett is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 93 since January 1, 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Pickett lives in Blowing Rock, North Carolina, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as co-managing the Blowing Rock Inn; he also served as president of the Rotary Club of Blowing Rock.
He took office in 2021, succeeding Ray Russell, a Democrat.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Pickett as chair of the Education - Universities Committee, vice chair of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Committee, and a member of the Appropriations, Appropriations on Capital, Environment, Local Government, House Transportation, and UNC BOG Nominations committees.
